Coram : A.K. SIKRI*, ASHOK BHUSHAN
8 S.C.R. 904 ATMA SINGH v. GURMEJ KAUR (D) & ORS. (Civil Appeal No. 11094 of 2017) SEPTEMBER 13,2107 [A.K. SIKRI AND ASHOK BHUSHAN, JJ.) Hindu Succession Act, 1956: s.8 - Intestate succession - By the mother - To the estate of C her deceased son born out of her first marriage - of Hindu Widows Re­ marriage Act, 1856 - s.4 of 1956 Act also gives an overriding effect D to the 1956 Act - Hence s.2 would not disentitle the mother (on account of her re-marriage) to inherit the estate of her son - Hindu Widows Re-marriage Act, 1856 - s.2 Dismissing the appeal, the Court
